child_briefs.title: Overseer WebUI chat panel — single SPA bundle leaf (clobber guard, per-turn mode labels, resend/rewind)
child_briefs.scope: EDIT the LIVE stdlib SPA bundle tools/webui_static/{app.js,index.html,styles.css} as ONE indivisible leaf, verified by the single committed oracle tests/overseer/test_chat_ui.py. In app.js: add pages.chat (append-only transcript element + persistent input textarea + mode selector + model dropdown + per-mode unlock affordance); wire a startSSE branch that routes overseer-chat tail lines (logs/overseer_chat.jsonl) into the transcript by conversation id; ADD chatIsOpen() to the boot() re-render skip guard so SSE ticks never clobber the panel; self-manage the chat DOM (append-only transcript, persistent input that is never wiped by an SSE tick). UX: (a) every transcript turn is a discrete user-selectable block with a per-block copy affordance and an editable affordance that performs a cache-friendly REWIND+branch via chat_resend(cid, rewind_to_index=N) (never in-place mid-edit); the input textarea supports select/copy/paste/edit. (b) per-turn color-coded mode label derived from the Turn.mode field, colored by mode/tier family, with the color map a single source of truth in styles.css. (c) a resend-transcript button calling chat_resend(cid) (whole transcript), with per-turn edit/rewind reusing the same endpoint via rewind_to_index; UI hints a likely cache miss past the ~5-min TTL but never blocks. index.html: add the #/chat nav link and chat panel markup. styles.css: add the single-source-of-truth per-mode color map plus styles for selectable/copyable blocks, the edit/rewind affordance, and the resend button. Drive to oracle-green via python -m pytest tests/overseer/test_chat_ui.py -q (or the frontend-test convention the committed oracle uses).
child_briefs.non_goals: Do NOT author or modify the oracle (tests/overseer/test_chat_ui.py is pre-committed). Do NOT split the bundle into multiple leaves — app.js, index.html, and styles.css ship together under the one oracle. Do NOT implement or touch any backend logic; call only the existing web_api endpoints (any backend work belongs to the external overseer_webui_backend epic, not here). Do NOT work in the DEAD webui/ Flask tree. Do NOT trap text selection or re-render over transcript blocks; do NOT rely on full-page re-render for the chat panel (use self-managed DOM + the chatIsOpen() guard). Do NOT implement an in-place mid-edit of a kept tail (edit == rewind+branch). Do NOT add any new network-exposed surface (loopback-only). Do NOT offer a model pick for the agy backend.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing SPA scaffolding in tools/webui_static/app.js: the SPA router/pages registry, startSSE, and the boot() re-render skip guard (to be extended with chatIsOpen()). Existing overseer JSON endpoints surfaced by overseer/web_api.py and routed via tools/webui_control.py, called as-is: chat_send(body), chat_history(cid), mode_get(cid), mode_set(cid, mode), mode_unlock(cid, mode), model_list(), and chat_resend(cid, *, rewind_to_index=None). The logs/overseer_chat.jsonl SSE tail relayed by tools/webui_server.py build_tailer over /events. The harness/config.yaml overseer: block models list (claude: [opus, sonnet, haiku]) for the model dropdown. The Turn.mode field (from overseer/transcript.py) for the per-turn color-coded label. These endpoints/relays are provided by the external backend work (overseer_webui_backend) and are treated here as a frozen contract — they are consumed, never authored. Authoritative contract: the committed oracle tests/overseer/test_chat_ui.py.
child_briefs.deliverables: Additive edits to three files forming one leaf: tools/webui_static/app.js (pages.chat with append-only transcript + persistent input + mode selector + model dropdown + per-mode unlock affordance; chatIsOpen() added to the boot() re-render skip guard; startSSE overseer-chat tail routing by conversation id; self-managed append-only transcript and persistent input; per-block copy and edit/rewind affordances; resend-transcript button; per-turn mode label from Turn.mode), tools/webui_static/index.html (#/chat nav link + chat panel markup), and tools/webui_static/styles.css (single-source-of-truth per-mode color map keyed by mode/tier family + styles for selectable/copyable blocks, the edit/rewind affordance, and the resend button). The frontend calls chat_send(body), chat_history(cid), mode_get(cid), mode_set(cid, mode), mode_unlock(cid, mode), model_list(), and chat_resend(cid, *, rewind_to_index=None); per-turn edit/rewind invokes chat_resend(cid, rewind_to_index=N) and whole-transcript resend invokes chat_resend(cid). One leaf, oracle-green via python -m pytest tests/overseer/test_chat_ui.py -q.
child_briefs.interfaces: Consumed (frozen, authored externally by overseer_webui_backend): chat_send(body), chat_history(cid), mode_get(cid), mode_set(cid, mode), mode_unlock(cid, mode), model_list(), chat_resend(cid, *, rewind_to_index=None); logs/overseer_chat.jsonl SSE tail over /events via tools/webui_server.py build_tailer; harness/config.yaml overseer.models (claude: [opus, sonnet, haiku]); Turn.mode from overseer/transcript.py. Produced (frontend): app.js adds chatIsOpen() to the boot() re-render skip guard; per-turn edit/rewind calls chat_resend(cid, rewind_to_index=N); whole-transcript resend calls chat_resend(cid). Authoritative contract: committed oracle tests/overseer/test_chat_ui.py.
